<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Extract normalized shapes of S-row and current P-row symbols
ascii_grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_normalized_symbol(r, c):
    """Extract 5x5 symbol and normalize (replace background with '.')"""
    result = ''
    for row in range(r, r+5):
        line = ascii_grid[row][c:c+5]
        # Replace S and P with '.', keep B
        line = line.replace('S', '.').replace('P', '.')
        result += line + '\n'
    return result

# S-row symbols
s_norms = {}
for i, c in enumerate([15, 22, 29, 36, 43]):
    s_norms[i] = get_normalized_symbol(41, c)

# Current P-row symbols
p_norms = {}
for i, c in enumerate([15, 22, 29, 36, 43]):
    p_norms[i] = get_normalized_symbol(52, c)

# Check current matches
print("Current S vs P shape matches:")
for i in range(5):
    match = s_norms[i] == p_norms[i]
    print(f"  Pos {i}: {'MATCH' if match else 'no match'}")

# Now let me cycle through P-row options at pos 0 and check for matches
# First, record current position
print(f"\nS-row pos 0 normalized:\n{s_norms[0]}")
print(f"P-row pos 0 normalized (current):\n{p_norms[0]}")

# Let me cycle through all options at pos 0
# Current cursor is at pos 0 (col 15). Let me cycle through all 7 options.
# I'll collect all normalized shapes by cycling DOWN 6 times

all_p_norms = {0: [p_norms[0]]}  # Start with current

# Cycle through remaining 6 options
for _ in range(6):
    action(['DOWN'])
    ascii_grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    norm = get_normalized_symbol(52, 15)
    all_p_norms[0].append(norm)

# Check if any match S-row pos 0
print(f"\nAll P-row pos 0 options ({len(all_p_norms[0])} total):")
match_found = False
for j, norm in enumerate(all_p_norms[0]):
    match = norm == s_norms[0]
    if match:
        print(f"  Option {j}: MATCH!")
        match_found = True
    else:
        print(f"  Option {j}: no match")

if not match_found:
    print("\nNo match found for S-row pos 0 - hypothesis may be wrong")

# Extract normalized shapes of S-row and current P-row symbols
ascii_grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_normalized_symbol(r, c):
    """Extract 5x5 symbol and normalize (replace background with '.')"""
    result = ''
    for row in range(r, r+5):
        line = ascii_grid[row][c:c+5]
        # Replace S and P with '.', keep B
        line = line.replace('S', '.').replace('P', '.')
        result += line + '\n'
    return result

# S-row symbols
s_norms = {}
for i, c in enumerate([15, 22, 29, 36, 43]):
    s_norms[i] = get_normalized_symbol(41, c)

for i, c in enumerate([15, 22, 29, 36, 43]):
